title: Multi-billion dollar propaganda book campaign

tellings.quote: But right next to them are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.

plain: A government official named John S. Herrington is said to have pointed to a shelf of books around 1981 and said that right beside the real ones sat "the books that we publish full of propaganda," part of "a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth." Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood and the CIA, repeats what he says Herrington told him. If true, it would mean the government paid to fill bookshops with false stories.
